summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Organizze financial management app - second iteration. All major features tested including cards management, predictions, charts with pie charts, notifications system, and transaction creation with credit card integration.

Cards CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Predictions endpoint returning 3 months of data
Pie chart reports by category and payment method
Notifications CRUD (create, read, mark as read, delete)
Dashboard summary with cards and financial data
Frontend navigation (6 pages: Dashboard, Lançamentos, Cartões, Metas, Previsões, Gráficos)
Cards page with card display and management
Charts page with pie chart and type switching
Notification bell with dropdown and badge
Transaction creation with credit card selector and installments
